goals.title: no function has more than 6 branch points
goals.why: One function decides four event kinds against four channels. Every new kind or channel means another branch in the same place, and no branch can be read without the others.

goals.title: no function is longer than 25 meaningful lines
goals.why: The routing decision, the reachability computation and the reason text are one body. None of them can be reused or tested apart.

goals.title: no logic is duplicated across modules
goals.why: The reachability block exists in notifications.mjs and audit.mjs. The two must agree and nothing makes them.
